## 说明

本函数生成CMSY++研究通常给出的两个表格：各种群的先验（所用年份、r和k的范围、MSY先验，以及第一年、中间年份和最后一年的B/k先验及其来源）和结果（r、k、MSY、Fmsy和Bmsy及其95%置信限，最后一年的B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy、Kobe象限概率和状态）。数值经过舍入，范围写作"low-high"（下限-上限），列名使用所选的语言。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function makes the two tables that CMSY++ studies usually give: the priors of each stock
(years used, r and k ranges, MSY prior, and the B/k priors of the first, intermediate and last
years, with their sources) and the results (r, k, MSY, Fmsy and Bmsy with their 95%
confidence limits, last-year B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy, Kobe probabilities and status). Values are
rounded and ranges written as "low-high", with the column names in the chosen language.

</details>

## 用法

```r
cmsy_tables(
  result,
  stocks = NULL,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)
```

## 参数

`result`
:   `cmsy_run()`的结果。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The result of `cmsy_run()`.

    </details>

`stocks`
:   要列入表格的种群（可选）：`Stock`标识，或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有已运行的种群。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    Optional stocks to put in the tables: `Stock` identifiers or species, by English or
    Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.

    </details>

`table`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/cmsy/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), the tables are saved in `tables/cmsy/`.

    </details>

`lang`
:   表格列名和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the column names and other names of the tables: "en" (English),
    "zh" (Chinese) or "both". Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
    `fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).

    </details>

`silent`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出种群匹配情况的提示信息。默认为FALSE，或`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, the messages on how the stocks were matched are not
    printed. Default is FALSE, or the value set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含数据框`priors`和`results`。结果表同时按FAO（2026）对仅基于渔获量结果的两级分类和Palomares等（2018）的五级分类给出状态。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a list with the data frames `priors` and `results`. The results give the
status in the two classes of FAO (2026) for catch-only results and in the five classes
of Palomares et al. (2018).

</details>

## 参考文献

FAO (2026). The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2026. Rome, FAO. Section "The status
of fishery resources", Box 1.3 (assessment tiers and status classes).
<https://openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/09d03e2f-7097-4d59-bf94-db65e95f44fd/content/sofia-2026/the-status-fishery-resources.html>

Palomares, M.L.D., Froese, R., Derrick, B., Noel, S.-L., Tsui, G., Woroniak, J. and Pauly, D.
(2018). A preliminary global assessment of the status of exploited marine fish and
invertebrate populations. A report prepared by the Sea Around Us for OCEANA. University of
British Columbia and GEOMAR. <https://www.fishbase.de/rfroese/OceanaFinalReport_V7a.pdf>

## 示例

```r
# result <- cmsy_run(...), see cmsy_run()
tables <- cmsy_tables(result, lang = "zh")       # also saved in tables/cmsy/
tables$priors
tables$results

# Column names in both languages, without saving
cmsy_tables(result, lang = "both", table = FALSE)$results
```
